# awx_ping (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `active_node` (String) Hostname of the node that answered this request.
- `ha` (Boolean) Whether the installation runs more than one node.
- `install_uuid` (String) Identifier unique to this installation, stable across restarts.
- `instance_groups` (String) The instance groups in the mesh, each with its capacity and member nodes. Capacity shifts as jobs run, so a config that reads this diffs on every plan.
- `instances` (String) The nodes in the mesh, each with its type, capacity and last heartbeat. Heartbeats move on their own, so a config that reads this diffs on every plan.
- `version` (String) The AWX version this installation runs, which is not necessarily the version the provider was generated against.
